rules.limitations: Use the complete native CH 50 kW condensing/modulating biomethane-boiler heat service per signed MJ of useful heat, factor +1, for the inspected source <100 kW useful-heat service. Both include fuel, boiler infrastructure, operating electricity and combustion emissions, without heat distribution. The native 50 kW size lies inside the source capacity class and replaces the prior 300 kW correspondence. Native heat uses 0.91324 MJ of the complete 50 kW burner per MJ of heat; its documentation estimates 109.5% efficiency on a lower-heating-value basis at 30% partial load and 2100 operating hours. These conditions are not established for the source. Retain the native complete heat inventory once; do not add a separate boiler/burner/electricity inventory or a capacity, fuel-demand, efficiency or operating-hours multiplier. Fuel pathway and pressure, measured versus modelled emissions, part load, delivery temperature, infrastructure, geography, vintage and background remain screening differences with unquantified score effects. No inventory or LCIA equality is claimed.
